appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: System follows your computer's light or dark setting.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Everything {{product}} syncs is stored in this folder on your computer.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.keychain: Your Canvas token and calendar feed addresses are kept in your system keychain, never in {{product}}'s database.
privacy.readOnly: {{product}} only reads from Canvas: it never posts or submits anything there.
privacy.aiProvider: Course text reaches an AI provider only when your AI app reads it to answer you.
privacy.perCourse: You can stop your AI app from reading any course's materials: open the course and use the switch on its “AI policy” tab.
privacy.notAcknowledged: You haven't confirmed this yet. You'll be asked when you set up a source.

help.title: Help & feedback
help.description: Something not working? These help find the cause. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you share it yourself.
help.reportHint: Version numbers, sync status and recent log lines. You'll see the whole report before anything is copied.
help.logsHint: {{product}}'s log files, in case someone helping you asks for them.
help.issueHint: Opens a new issue in your browser. Paste the diagnostic report there.

fileReader.blocked: {{product}}'s file reader couldn't start (often blocked by antivirus or Smart App Control). Until it can run, PDFs of any size and other files over 5 MB aren't read.
fileReader.mismatch: {{product}}'s file reader is from a different version. Reinstall {{product}} to fix it.

kinds.spawn_failed: {{count}} waiting for the reader to start
